One of the most legendary comedy moments ever put on film. In this iconic scene from Tropic Thunder (2008), Robert Downey Jr. delivers the unforgettable line that became a global meme while fully committed to his character, method actor Kirk Lazarus.

During a heated discussion about acting roles, Lazarus breaks down the difference between serious dramatic performances and going too far, delivering the now-infamous “Never go full retard” line. The scene perfectly showcases the razor-sharp satire of Tropic Thunder, poking fun at Hollywood method acting and award-season drama performances.

Robert Downey Jr.’s fearless performance as Kirk Lazarus is widely considered one of the greatest comedic performances of the 2000s, earning him an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor. The combination of brilliant writing, perfect timing, and Downey Jr.’s complete commitment to the role turned this moment into one of the most quoted comedy scenes in movie history.
